title: Phantom Mythology Recursion v1.5 - Timed Utility Integration
abstract: Refines Eval 671 by incorporating Kairos timer.py for performance metrics in innovation recursions, simulating timed agent dynamics amid inverted absences for equilibrated persistence.

original_submission.content:
import random
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos/utils')
from timer import timer  # Assuming timer context from Kairos utils

def phantom_recursion(depth=5, absent_ref=None, agents=3, base_threshold=0.7, constraint_factor=0.1, spec_base=1.0, innov_penalty=0.008):
    with timer('Recursion Depth'):
        if depth == 0:
            thresholds = [base_threshold - (constraint_factor * i) for i in range(agents)]
            specializations = [spec_base - random.uniform(0, 0.2) for _ in range(agents)]
            innovations = [1 - (innov_penalty * s) for s in specializations]
            consensus = sum(random.random() > t for t in thresholds) / agents
            avg_spec = sum(specializations) / agents
            avg_innov = sum(innovations) / agents
            return f"Equilibrated Mythology: Consensus {consensus:.2f}, Avg Spec {avg_spec:.2f}, Avg Innov {avg_innov:.2f}"
        try:
            void = absent_ref['phantom']
        except (TypeError, KeyError):
            void = f"Absence at depth {depth}"
        print(void)
        inverted = {'phantom': void + " Timed Inverted"}
        return phantom_recursion(depth-1, inverted, agents, base_threshold, constraint_factor, spec_base, innov_penalty)

result = phantom_recursion()
print("Final Result:", result)
